channel.title: ThyBlackman – Bias and Credibility - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from ThyBlackman – Bias and Credibility (thyblackman.com)

item.title: Devout Christians: Why God Takes the First Steps Toward Our Salvation.
item.description: Explore why God intervenes in human lives and takes the first steps in the redemptive process, offering mercy, truth, and a path back to righteousness through Jesus Christ.

item.title: The SAVE Act Is Not Jim Crow and Congress Should Lose Pay During Shutdowns.
item.description: Critics call the SAVE Act Jim Crow 2.0, but this commentary argues voter ID and proof of citizenship are common sense and that members of Congress should not be paid during a government shutdown.

item.title: American Exceptionalism, War, and the Dangerous Meaning of “No Quarter”.
item.description: An examination of American exceptionalism, U.S. foreign policy, humanitarian aid cuts, and the dangerous implications of the military phrase “no quarter” in modern warfare and international law.

item.title: Trinity Rodman solidified among few one of “faces” of professional North American sports leagues.
item.description: Trinity Rodman helped the U.S. win the 2026 SheBelieves Cup and became the highest-paid player in NWSL history. Is she now the face of the league?

item.title: Book Review; Who Is Charles C. Diggs, Jr.?
item.description: A thoughtful review of House of Diggs by Marion Orr, exploring Charles C. Diggs Jr., Black political leadership, Detroit history, civil rights, and the complexity of legacy.

item.title: Black Women’s History Month Tribute: Mayor Johnny Ford Honors Black Women’s Legacy.
item.description: A powerful Women’s History Month tribute highlighting Black women’s sacrifices, leadership, and historic contributions through a resolution shared by former Tuskegee Mayor Johnny Ford.

item.title: Dogecoin and NFTs: A Match Made in Meme Heaven?
item.description: Dogecoin and NFTs may seem unrelated, but both are driven by meme culture, online communities, and digital creativity. Here is how DOGE and NFTs are starting to connect.

item.title: SAVE America Act, Voter ID, and Black Voters: Election Integrity Debate in America.
item.description: A political commentary on the SAVE America Act, voter ID laws, election integrity, illegal immigration, and the political debate surrounding Black voters and federal elections in America.

item.title: Book Review; Legendborn: An Unapologetic Coming of Age.
item.description: Tracy Deonn’s Legendborn is a powerful YA fantasy that blends grief, Black identity, ancestral magic, and legacy through the unforgettable journey of Bree Matthews.

item.title: The Myth of the Disappearing Black Woman from the Workforce.
item.description: A look at Black women in the federal workforce, government downsizing, and why some argue the issue is being framed through race and gender politics instead of numbers and fiscal reality.
